audit_identity.independent_reviewer_type: AI Agent computational and artifact audit

method.implementation: Independent Python standard-library audit, executed inline. Did not import or call official scorer, run API requests, or run extraction/tests. Expected typed keys freshly reconstructed from frozen gold/records/regression input plus frozen metadata, then compared to cases.json.
method.raw_source: graph.entities and graph.relations from observations.json and rebuild-check.json; each raw graph also compared exactly with its archived HTTP response.
method.normalization: Unicode NFKC, casefold, collapse whitespace; preserve punctuation, label content and entity types. No synonyms, substring matching, numeric fragment repair or label substitution.
method.directed_identity: Use actual source and target entity IDs, entity_type and raw label; project/note/user stable identities bound from entity origin source_type/source_id to actual project/note/operator database identities. Note identity keeps record ID. Business entity identity is blank as declared by protocol.
method.provenance_filter: All graph project IDs, relation origin note ID, relation origin type and endpoint project IDs checked. Metadata origin must be note, business content origin must be note_extraction. Unknown relation types counted outside scope without discarding them silently.
method.counts: Set intersection/difference of complete typed directed keys; count repeated relation database IDs separately from repeated typed keys. Scored each arm separately and each of content/metadata/all separately.
method.metrics: TP=|pred∩gold|, FP=|pred−gold|, FN=|gold−pred|; P=TP/(TP+FP), R=TP/(TP+FN), F1=2TP/(2TP+FP+FN). Return null when a denominator is zero. Exact is equality of sets, including both empty. Macro F1 excludes only notes with undefined F1 and records its denominator.
method.comparison: Compared every official metric leaf, including per-note values, all seven by-relation groups, FP/FN typed key lists, duplicate counts and macro denominators; floating equality tolerance 1e-12. Checked rebuild set and multiplicity equality, status/IDs/run ownership and entity/relation response counts.
method.annotation_scope: Audit verifies frozen reference/input correspondence and timing; it is not independent human annotation or a re-assessment of every source-PDF interpretation.

reference.identity: AI-assisted pre-output reference, no human annotator
reference.annotator: research-reviewer Agent; product-manager Agent blind review; root Agent adjudication

interpretation: Body arm has no scientific/business relations for all 12 natural English records; 74 nonempty reference relations are missed. Two records have empty scientific reference and therefore exact empty output, with undefined per-note F1; they are excluded from content macro-F1 denominator (10).

Fields arm is a label-serialization/extraction control with frozen gold labels supplied as fixed fields, not free-text scientific understanding. One comma-containing sample label is split into three predicted labels; this yields three content FP and one content FN.

Regression arm reuses four known development examples and its frozen 52-relation reference. The extra bare sample label 2 in qPCR contributes one FP; 40 content and 12 metadata reference relations are retained.
Metadata relations are correct in all arms, but content and metadata metrics are reported separately because merging correct metadata can inflate apparent body extraction performance.
All 28 manual rebuilds preserve scored relation sets and multiplicities, including the observed split-label errors. Rebuild stability verifies repeatability, not scientific extraction correctness.

This small paired three-source English input set and known regression controls do not establish overall language coverage, external validity, human annotation accuracy, population performance or a significance claim. Approval was exercised by the frozen super_admin test operator.
